title: Beal
statement: If positive integers A,B,C and exponents x,y,z>2 satisfy A^x+B^y=C^z, then A,B,C have a common prime factor.

counterexample.description: Primitive positive integers satisfying \(A^x+B^y=C^z\), with \(x,y,z>2\) and \(\gcd(A,B,C)=1\). Exact exponentiation and gcd checking verify a tuple.
